text:
Hello to relief team,
The front-counter lead asked me to write about water breaks, so I am passing along a quick reminder from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Please step away from the counter when you need a break, even if the line looks steady, because keeping our focus sharp helps with pet check-ins, carrier checks, and the small details that keep trips moving smoothly. If you notice a service change while you are away from the desk, please add it to the desk ledger as soon as you return so the next person has the same clear picture.

We also want to keep the handoff notes simple and complete. When a traveler looks worried, the supervisor on shift will listen carefully and help sort out the concern, but the rest of us can make that easier by keeping our own notes neat and current. If you see a hazard, a spill, or anything that could get in the way of safe work, let the safety coordinator know right away so the fix can happen before it becomes a bigger problem. Little habits like that make a real difference in a busy room.

Aurelia Skyways depends on us to keep companion travel dependable, calm, and kind. Please keep using the break plan in a way that supports the desk and your own energy, and please remember that a short pause is part of good service, not a detour from it. A rested team gives better answers, catches more issues, and leaves travelers feeling cared for from the first greeting to the final handoff.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
